description: v0.13.0 docs refresh on an NVIDIA L4 (AWS g6.4xlarge, 16 vCPUs): the published v0.13.0 Linux CUDA 13 package (new) against v0.12.0's (old). speed: the docs speed list of aws-g6-l4-speed-v06's spd.py (scripts/spd13.py: each set repeated to >= 1,000 MP, the lossless and RGBA sets as published; a warm-up then 3 timed runs with --stats, 2 rounds with the binary order alternating; median of the 6 timed runs; keys as aws-g6-g7-v090-check). quality: av1gpu's side re-encoded and re-scored (libjxl 0.11.1 ssimulacra2, libavif 1.4.0 avifdec with dav1d, cvvdp 0.5.7) against the stored CPU / NVENC baselines, as aws-g6-l4-tiles4x4 (same keys); v0120_on_l4 = the same numbers for v0.12.0.
